description: Shadowrun: Dragonfall — Director's Cut (Harebrained Schemes 2014, native Linux, GOG v2.0.9)
long: Shadowrun: Dragonfall - Director's Cut is a 2014 tactical RPG set in the cyberpunk-fantasy Shadowrun universe. Players lead a team of shadowrunners through a story-driven campaign in the Berlin Flux State, mixing magic, technology, and turn-based combat. The Director's Cut adds new missions, characters, and improved gameplay over the original release.
